questions.question: What is the primary advantage of using Cloud AI services?
options: They provide computing resources and AI services on demand.
They eliminate the need for machine learning models.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes Cloud AI?
options: Running AI models only on personal laptops
Using internet-based servers to train or deploy AI systems
Storing models only on USB drives

questions.question: A startup uses cloud services to access powerful GPUs without purchasing expensive hardware. This demonstrates:
Why is cloud computing particularly useful for training large AI models?
options: It reduces the need for data.
It provides scalable computing resources when needed.

questions.question: Scalability in AI systems refers to the ability to:
options: Increase the number of features automatically
Handle increasing amounts of data or users efficiently

questions.question: An image-generation service suddenly receives ten times more users than usual. A scalable system should:
options: Add more computing resources to handle the demand

questions.question: Which situation best demonstrates scalability?
options: A system serves 100 users and cannot handle 101 users.
A system automatically increases resources during heavy traffic.
A model's accuracy increases after retraining.

questions.question: In AI deployment, performance often refers to:
options: How fast and efficiently the system produces predictions
The color of the user interface
The number of training examples only

questions.question: A chatbot that takes 20 seconds to answer each question has a problem with:
Latency in an AI system measures:
options: The time taken to respond to a request

questions.question: A recommendation system processes thousands of requests every second without slowing down. This indicates good:
What is a deployment tradeoff?
options: A method of deleting old models
A compromise between competing goals such as speed, cost, and accuracy
A way to improve every metric simultaneously

questions.question: A company chooses a smaller model because it responds much faster, even though its accuracy is slightly lower. This is an example of:
Which pair of objectives often conflicts in real-world AI deployment?
Why might a company avoid deploying its largest and most accurate model?
options: Large models may be too expensive or slow to serve.
Large models do not require training.

questions.question: A mobile app uses a smaller AI model directly on the phone instead of a huge cloud model. The likely reason is:
options: To reduce latency and resource requirements

questions.question: Which statement about cloud AI is TRUE?
options: Cloud AI always costs less than local computing in every situation.
Cloud AI provides flexible access to powerful computing resources.
Cloud AI eliminates the need for monitoring.
Cloud AI can only be used by large companies.

questions.question: A streaming service automatically allocates more servers during a major sports event and reduces them afterward. This is an example of:
An AI engineer must choose between a model with 99% accuracy that takes 10 seconds to respond and a model with 97% accuracy that responds in 0.1 seconds. This decision primarily involves:
Which sequence best represents building a high-quality cloud AI system?
options: Train → Deploy on cloud → Monitor scalability and performance → Optimize tradeoffs
